text: One concert. One camera. One moment the internet can't stop sharing. What if you could play it?
First, find the hook. The surprise? Getting caught on the big screen. The challenge? Stay out of the spotlight!
Turn that feeling into one simple rule. Move. Hide. Don't get caught. That's our game idea.
Now make it playable. A moving spotlight. A player marker. A timer. Test the tension, adjust the speed, and make that next attempt irresistible.
Give it a look, a name, and a punchline. Camera Dodge. Eighteen seconds of fame? Let's see your friends beat that!
Package the funniest moment into a short clip. Add a score worth sharing. Launch while the original story is still everywhere!
Then watch what happens. Do people replay? Do they share? Learn from every response, and make the next version better.
Too Soon Games. From everyone's feed to everyone's next game.
